subject.title: Enhancement: Developer experience quick wins from code analysis

question: Where should the remaining non-tool skill-routing signal appear: operator trace or verbose diagnostics, an always-on gateway warning, or nowhere beyond documentation and trajectory inspection?
rationale: The code can emit a signal mechanically, but its audience and default visibility affect log noise, shared-channel privacy, and the intended distinction between normal model routing and deterministic tool dispatch.

options.title: Trace-only diagnostic
options.body: Emit a structured routing event only in operator trace or verbose diagnostics, preserving quiet default behavior.

options.title: Always-on gateway warning
options.body: Log every model-routed skill invocation by default, maximizing visibility at the cost of recurring operator noise.

options.title: Documentation only
options.body: Treat the existing command documentation and trajectory tooling as sufficient and close the remaining request.

recommendation.title: Trace-only diagnostic
recommendation.body: Emit a structured routing event only in operator trace or verbose diagnostics, preserving quiet default behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They already reviewed and retained the remaining routing-observability decision and are the strongest available routing candidate from the issue and source history.
